test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Change the following sentence from direct speech to indirect speech and choose the correct sentence from the given options.

The students said, “We wish we didn’t have to write exams.”

options.text: The students say we wish they had not written exams.
The students said they wished they have not written exams.
The students say that we wish we do not write exams.
The students said that they wished they didn’t have to write exams.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in direct speech and the task is to convert it into reported speech.
 
• The phrase “We wish we didn’t have to write exams” becomes "they wished they didn't have to write exams" in reported speech - changing the first person 'we' to third person 'they'.
 
• Thus, we have: "The students said that they wished they didn’t have to write exams.”
 
• It is critical to note that when changing from direct to reported speech, we maintain the tense if it’s in the present form, otherwise we move the tense one step back. Since "didn't" is in the past, it remains the same in reported speech.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 ('The students say we wish they had not written exams') and Option 3 ('The students say that we wish we do not write exams') are both in the present tense and change the meaning of the original sentence.
 
• Option 2 ('The students said they wished they have not written exams') is flawed because it incorrectly uses the present perfect tense 'have not written', instead of the correct past form 'did not have to write'.
